title: CS3264 Project (Group 13)
summary: A university course project for CS3264: Foundations of Machine Learning that builds diabetes prediction models and analyzes a Kaggle diabetes dataset, using data augmentation for class balance as one of its advanced ML topics. The advanced_ml/vae.py script imports SDV's TVAESynthesizer with conditional sampling to generate synthetic positive-class diabetes records for augmenting the training data.
evidence: advanced_ml/vae.py:7 'synthesizer = TVAESynthesizer(metadata, batch_size=1000, epochs=300, verbose=1)' then Condition(num_rows=20000, column_values={'diabetes': 1})
